title: Harden full-recrawl postflight health retries and failure propagation
source_ref: ops/ledgers/full-recrawl-closeout-2026-07-31.md; tools/recrawl-health.log shows the July 31 full recrawl closed green at 09:59:13 PT and the 11:30 seed refresh closed green at 11:40:05 PT, with no crawl or discovery lock remaining at 12:09 PT. The July 30 full recrawl recorded completion with api_status=000 api_ok=0. Current tools/recrawl-common.sh finish_wrapper still performs one postflight probe, records completion regardless of api_ok, and returns success. Bounded live proof: health status=ok db=ok, total_sites=4343 avg_score=38, developer=1320, other=850, spam=1.
acceptance_criteria: Preserve the July 31 aggregate closeout and do not start another full recrawl to reproduce the July 30 postflight failure.
Add bounded postflight health retries with logged attempt counts, backoff, final HTTP status, and final api_ok state.
Return nonzero when postflight health remains unhealthy after retries so the installed launchd and sync-state retry path can act.
Run IndexNow only after a healthy postflight and log an explicit skip reason otherwise.
Release the local run lock on success, remote-command failure, postflight failure, interruption, and dry-run paths.
Add fixture tests for immediate success, transient 000 then 200, persistent failure, remote-command failure, exit status, IndexNow gating, and lock release.
Verify the installed recurring path on a later scheduled bounded run records either healthy completion or explicit failed/retry state; do not use a manual broad recrawl as the acceptance test.

title: Make MCP monitor registration consent-aware and redact PII telemetry
source_ref: marketing/mcp-register-monitor-consent-privacy-handoff-2026-07-31.md plus 2026-07-31T19:09Z bounded proof: live /monitor returns 200 while /privacy and /terms remain 404. Source proof still shows register_monitor requires email and domain without a consent field or side-effect annotations, immediately calls models.RegisterMonitor, returns an unsubscribe management token, and stores full arguments in both mcp_requests.arguments and intent_events.metadata.arguments. Redacted aggregates are active=5 and quarantined=3. The July 31 full recrawl and seed refresh both closed green and no crawl lock remains.
acceptance_criteria: Do not register a monitor or use a third-party email while implementing or testing this repair.
Add a pending-confirmation state and one-time confirmation flow; only confirmed rows are eligible for scheduled checks and alerts, while shared-host quarantine remains intact.
Require an explicit consent or inbox-ownership assertion and advertise the email side effect through the MCP tool description and side-effect annotations.

Redact at the shared MCP logging boundary so raw emails, confirmation tokens, and unsubscribe tokens cannot enter mcp_requests.arguments or intent_events.metadata; retain only allowlisted aggregate fields.

Return stable status and confirmation-delivery fields, avoid exposing an unsubscribe token before confirmation, keep duplicates idempotent, and replace raw internal error propagation with bounded public error classes.

Add tests for missing consent, pending registration, confirmation, expired and replayed tokens, duplicates, delivery failure, legacy active rows, quarantine, rate limits, analytics redaction, token non-disclosure, and REST/MCP parity.

After a later product-worker deploy, verify the MCP schema, confirmation delivery, activation, unsubscribe, redacted analytics, REST parity, and monitor-worker eligibility with a Foundry-owned test inbox.

title: Make score-fix funnel analytics aggregate-safe before owner growth
source_ref: marketing/score-fix-funnel-measurement-handoff-2026-07-31.md plus 2026-07-31T19:09Z bounded proof: /score, /report, and /monitor return 200; /privacy, /terms, and /.well-known/agent-card.json return 404. Seven-day artifact aggregates record 12005 site_report_view events, 7951 fix_page_view events, 71 score_page_view events, and 4 score_checked events, but no published aggregate-safe cohort or attribution contract. The admin traffic response still lacks route_buckets and scanner_pages. Fresh redacted score-fix proof has 10 real-candidate pending rows: 7 aged 30d+ and 3 aged 7-29d, with no real-candidate paid or lead rows.
acceptance_criteria: Define stable funnel events for report view, eligibility evaluation, score view, score completion, fix-form start, valid intake, checkout start, payment, and fulfillment start, with backward-compatible mapping from current event names.

Expose only day, source family, coarse score band, bounded eligibility reason, bot or human classification, payment mode, and aggregate counts; never expose raw hosts, emails, visit ids, IP hashes, user agents, queries, referrers, payment ids, checkout URLs, tokens, or arbitrary metadata.
Add aggregate route_buckets and scanner_pages so discovery, profile/report, score, fix, monitor, commerce, and scanner traffic can be separated without per-path domain disclosure.
Make recurring-worker analytics aggregate-only by default and separately gate or remove recent-event metadata and entity-level drilldowns from that path.
Use allowlisted attribution values and a bounded dedupe window; keep views, human-classified requests, form starts, valid intakes, checkout starts, payments, and fulfillment as distinct counts.
Add fixtures for scanners, bots, repeated views, missing visit ids, eligibility states, abandoned checkout, completed payment, test-like rows, and aggregate redaction.

After a later product-worker deploy, collect one full week of aggregate-safe baseline data before increasing owner-channel volume and reconcile only aggregate funnel counts against the redacted score-fix helper.
Do not suggest monitor registration from this funnel until the separate monitor consent, confirmation, token, and telemetry repair is complete.
